projector_nonmonotonic.not_a_logger_bucket_mislabel: param_bucket maps only RadialAngularProjector params (radial_mlp + angular_proj + scalar_proj; 7 tensors / 177 params). No foreign modules leak into 'projector'.
likely_contributors: Telemetry probe is a SECOND SDRP backward on train_batches[0] only (single structure), while the Adam step averages 11 train structures — single-structure α-sensitive probe amplifies variance.

Projector α = σ(radial_mlp(s)) * tau_ceiling sits on a sigmoid + curriculum radius; small weight moves can jump grad L2 without a global loss spike (observed: projector spikes while attn/sdrp keep decaying).
Small param count → L2 more sensitive to individual tensor spikes than moe/attn aggregates.
projector_nonmonotonic.ruling_now: Mostly consistent with real α/tau-coupled dynamics + single-structure probe artifact — NOT a dead/misbucketed module. Not evidence of wiring failure.
projector_nonmonotonic.primary_explanation: single-structure probe backward vs 11-structure-mean Adam step — measurement property, not model property
projector_nonmonotonic.required_on_next_card: Log bucket grads from the same multi-structure backward as the train step (see tokyo_eye_equ_grad_telemetry_next_card_design.json decision 1). Not optional.

G_grad_spine_PASS_threshold.current_definition: bucket_status == NZ AND grad_l2 > 0.0 (float). No magnitude floor. See science/tokyo_eye/v8/grad_reachability.py::assert_sdrp_live_spine_reachable.

G_grad_spine_PASS_threshold.risk: PASS currently means 'in graph and not exactly zero' — same NONE/ZERO/NZ trichotomy from the dehydron work — NOT 'above a meaningful utilization floor'. A weak-but-nonzero connection that later collapses toward machine epsilon would still PASS step-0.
G_grad_spine_PASS_threshold.ruling_now: Threshold is intentional for the wiring gate (graph membership), and that is what L-wiring-capacity-separation established. It is NOT a strength/utilization gate.
G_grad_spine_PASS_threshold.next_card_split: A = membership (keep). B = G_grad_spine_rel RATIO to sdrp_head at same step (form locked; r_min unsigned until M2 step-0 baseline). See tokyo_eye_equ_grad_telemetry_next_card_design.json.
